notes: Source: questions.examside.com JEE Main Physics chapter pages, scraped in full (all 2024-2026 shifts, both sessions). Coverage checked: per-year totals across all chapters = 600 (2024, 20 shifts x 30), 475 (2025, 19 x 25), 475 (2026, 19 x 25). Each relevant chapter's 2024-26 list was read question by question, and other chapters were keyword-scanned (rolling found in circular-motion and center-of-mass, buoyancy in SHM, X-ray in EM waves). No separate MathonGo or PW cross-check was done because the examside data is complete. Counting was by judgement: a question counts only if the topic is needed to solve it. Borderline calls: buoyancy counts terminal-velocity questions that need the (rho - sigma) term (floating/Archimedes-only count is 2/2/3); pseudo force counts questions whose natural method is a non-inertial frame (accelerating wedge, turning car, rotating table); RC/LR DC counts transients and t=0 analysis only, not steady-state DC circuits with capacitors or inductors (capacitor steady-state 5/1/2 for 2024/2025/2026); 'RC, LR and LC with AC source' counts two-element circuits only (pure L or C and full LCR excluded); Angular SHM counts physical pendulums and angular-acceleration-of-pendulum questions, not ordinary simple-pendulum period questions. Zero in all three years: Blackbody/Kirchhoff, Damped/forced oscillations, Doppler effect, Rectilinear propagation, Moseley's law. Radioactivity (all three nuclei topics) has 0 questions in 2024 and only appears in 2025-2026.
